dedupe_keys.name: accumulation based runoff and pluvial flood estimation tool accro

description: AccRo estimates pluvial-flood maxima from flow accumulation, terrain, roughness and surface-runoff intensities. Hannes Leistert and the University of Freiburg team publish the model code and exemplary test data in a versioned Zenodo archive. The method uses Python richDEM flow accumulation and iterative hydraulic adjustments. Users define the domain and grid; the describing study evaluates a two-metre grid in the Riedgraben catchment alongside synthetic tests. Outputs can support screening of flood exposure for drainage, roads and buildings. The code archive is free under MIT, and a separate DOI supplies validation data and analysis scripts. A central limitation is that AccRo estimates maximum depth, velocity and specific discharge, not their complete temporal evolution. Its derived hydrograph also uses simplifying travel-time assumptions. The registry identifies the code package but does not enumerate internal file formats or a complete runtime environment. No directly related catalogue record was found, and neither archive was downloaded nor the model executed.
